description: Reviewed, consciously accepted security advisories. scripts/check-dependency-audit.mjs blocks CI on any high/critical production advisory NOT listed here, and on any entry past its 'expires' date — so an acceptance is a dated decision that must be re-reviewed, never a permanent mute. Add an entry only after checking reachability in our own code; record how you checked in 'reason'.

advisories.reason: DoS in the JXL/HEIF image parsers. Not reachable: lib/slides/pptxBuilder.ts (the only pptxgenjs user) builds slides from shapes/text/colours and never calls addImage, so image-size never parses input. Re-verified 2026-10-12 (no addImage/image-size use in lib/app/components). No upstream fix.
DoS in the ICNS image parser. Not reachable for the same reason as GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq: no image is ever added to a generated deck. Re-verified 2026-10-12. No upstream fix.
